study_design: Single-arm lycopene-enriched dietary intervention with 6-month follow-up biopsy among patients with HGPIN
cohort_total_n_excerpt: Thirty-two patients diagnosed with HGPIN were administered a lycopene-enriched diet (20-25 mg/day of lycopene; through 30 g/day of triple concentrated tomato paste) for 6 months.
reason: The study assesses development of prostate cancer after HGPIN in participants without diagnosed prostate cancer at baseline. This is general incident prostate cancer, but no aggressive subtype is defined or analyzed.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Prostatic lycopene concentration below a 1 ng/mg threshold was associated with PC at 6-month follow-up biopsy (p = 0.003).
estimate_classifications.reason: The endpoint is development of prostate cancer at follow-up biopsy, without an aggressive disease restriction. The numeric OR and calculated confidence interval are not reported in the abstract.
